candidates.change_summary: Replace the require condition from msg.sender == owner to msg.sender != owner, inverting access control so anyone except the owner can withdraw.
Delete the require statement, allowing anyone to call withdrawAll and drain the contract balance.
Replace the transfer amount from address(this).balance to 0, so the recipient receives nothing even when the call succeeds.
Replace the recipient address in the transfer with the owner variable, so funds go to the owner instead of the caller-specified recipient.
